description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single physical attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], and Crystal Mode to the user
Crystal Mode: Lightning Ability Boost, Dualcast Lightning, Zero Hone Cost to Lightning Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 4 single-target Lightning/NE physical attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage +30% Boost 1] to Spellblade and XII allies, grants [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
